Proprietary Name:
Infant Flow Nasal CPAP Masks
Common Name:
Nasal CPAP Masks
Intended Use:
SensorMedics Infant Flow System, consisting of a Driver and NCPAP Generator.
It is intended to provide CPAP with a nasal mask for use in hospitals to treat
newborms and infants with RDS or who are recovering from RDS.
Description:
The SensorMedics Infant Flow Nasal CPAP Mask is a silicone mask that fits into
the generator of the Infant Flow System in place of the standard nasal prongs.
Clinical and Non-Clinical Tests of Equivalency:
The Infant Flow Mask is similar in purpose to the Hans Rudolph CPAP Mask
(K962848) and provides the same function as the nasal CPAP prongs of the
SensorMedics Infant Flow System (K974303) and Hamilton Aladdin CPAP
System (K960359 and K945740).
between the SensorMedics Infant Flow System prongs and the SensorMedics
Infant Flow Mask, no additional clinical tests were performed or submitted in the

data.
Non-clinical testing of the Infant Flow System using the mask as compared to the
prongs demonstrated no differences in safety or effectiveness.
